{{Quote|First, planted special karg grease lure&mdash;irresistible to rancors. Then built a hide, and got perfect shot.|Qyzen Fess, on how he hunted rancors|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Karg grease''' was a substance that [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] found irresistible. The [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Qyzen Fess]] used karg grease to attract rancors while hunting them.
